sindresorhus__escape-string-regexp-20.title: Escape hyphens in Unicode regular expressions
sindresorhus__escape-string-regexp-20.task_text: At the pinned upstream revision, escaped hyphens produce a SyntaxError in JavaScript Unicode regex mode. Make literal hyphens usable both in a Unicode pattern and within a character class. Preserve existing metacharacter escaping, rejection of non-string values and empty-string behavior. This is a historical upstream issue, not a newly discovered vulnerability.
